_comment: Mutation kill-rate thresholds, read by BOTH report scripts: src/release/check_mutation_gate.py
(mutmut, over the Python islands) and src/release/checkMutationGate.mts (Stryker, over
src/builder/ + src/release/). Single-sourced so the two runtimes cannot hold two answers.
gate is 0 on purpose: NOTHING is required of the kill rate. Mutation testing is a developer
tool here (`make test-mutation`), not a CI job and not a release gate — a run reports the score
and the surviving mutants, and a human decides what a survivor is worth. warn stays at 95 so a
local run still says where the campaign stands; a warning prints, nothing fails. Raising gate
above 0 re-arms both scripts as gates, and is the one edit that does.
